scope: Collect immutable newknife measurements, training, and native results by evidence type.

assumptions.mass_split: 80/20 percent engineering estimate; uniform-volume part COM, compound-box inertia approximation
assumptions.collision: 2mm floor,2.5mm side rails,rear cap,0.5mm chamfer and internal blade carrier are photo-informed engineering assumptions
assumptions.joint_limits: -10 to55mm relative initial; unmeasured, targets not endstops

asset.model_route: Parameterized URDF; no existing Hunyuan workflow found, simple measured contact geometry more direct

model.variable: reference is forward running mean; +/-8% sinusoidal position variation; return factor0.90; near-rest1.12reference; all curve shapes are assumptions

isolated_evidence.rejected: profiles-v1/v2 variable tests hit endstops; no sustainedforce inference from their endstop portions
isolated_evidence.near_threshold_motion: known0.7365N ->15.074mm in0.6s in each direction;0.735N remains bounded creep~0.029mm/s

reference_resistance.scope: Fixture calibration of passivecapacity in simulation, not realknife curve fit or successful robot task

task_criterion.reference: q_slider minus initial before episode, not rail lower
task_criterion.old_functional_criterion: Unchanged historical comparison; report individual rotation/contact/drift checks
task_criterion.scope: No hardware or fully hidden blade claim

training.scope: Training fitting only, all four fixed100update pilots completed; native evaluation remains pending

evaluation.scope: Simulation only; return to task initial, not proven hidden blade; legacy lower-stop score reported separately
